Data sources, calculations, and limitations

Every activity record comes through heidrun_data. This page uses the daily dataset already computed for the calendar: heidrun_code_heidrun_notebook_heidrun_data_daily_activity_metrics_2025-10-24_to_2026-10-23.json. No activity data is fetched from another source by this page.

  • Commits: Count commits by committedAt, including merge commits and all authors.
  • Pull requests opened: Count pull requests by createdAt, regardless of their later state. A pull request and a commit can describe the same work.
  • Lines changed: Sum insertions plus deletions for non-merge commits, grouped by committedAt. Merge commits are excluded to avoid counting edits again at merge time. Includes all file types recorded by Git, including generated files and formatting changes; measures editing volume, not quality or productivity.
  • AI tokens: Sum fresh input, cached input, cache-write input, and output tokens by minuteAt. Includes the repository’s recorded worktree and subfolder usage. An operation is assigned to the minute of its usage record, rather than spread over its duration.
  • Estimated AI cost (US dollars): Sum costUsd from token_usage_with_cost by minuteAt. Uses the latest stored model-price version in each database for every date. This is an estimate from public model prices, not an invoice or subscription payment. Unpriced records produce a partial estimate; completely unpriced days are unavailable.

Dates use Europe/Paris time. Days with no recorded commits, pull requests, or tokens are omitted. A day is excluded when any selected measure is unavailable, or when selected dollar cost has an unknown model price. Missing data is not zero. Zero means no activity recorded in the available snapshot, not proof that no activity occurred. Later activity and undated token usage are excluded. The last day may be incomplete.

All selected repositories share each axis scale. Linear axes start at zero; logarithmic axes use log(1 + value) to preserve zero. Tick labels always show original units. Coincident points may overlap; rotate or filter repositories to explore them. Lines changed means additions plus deletions in non-merge commits.
